verdict.rationale: Dropbox ships AI features such as Dash, which searches team knowledge across apps, so letting users plug in MCP servers is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the pack shows Dropbox acting as an MCP client or registering external MCP servers. "Integrate with leading AI tools" and the SDKs and APIs are adjacent capabilities, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
